capabilities: Create multiple variants of selected words, phrases, or sentences
Preview each variant in context with a single click
Reorder variants by dragging to prioritize favorites
Commit the chosen variant to replace the variant syntax
Commit all variants in a selection or document at once
extras: Files shared with users without the plugin show the raw variant syntax ({{variant1|variant2}}^INDEX); variants can also be created by typing this syntax manually.
motivation: The author built it because finding the perfect phrasing requires exploring multiple variations, and writers keep deleting and rewriting the same sentence over and over.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep alternative phrasings of the same text side-by-side while drafting, so writers delete and rewrite sentences repeatedly.
summary: Writing plugin that stores multiple variants of words or sentences in a special syntax and lets you preview, compare, and commit them in context.
